status: public-source research; not approved by BOI
operationalBoundary: For private evaluation only. No BOI systems, applicant records, lending decisions or approvals connected.

sources.title: 2025–2027 Corporate Strategy
claims: BOI describes six focus areas: MSME financing; infrastructure growth; gender and women; youth and skills; climate resilience; digital transformation and technology.
The Bank aims to deepen sustainable and inclusive industrial development and improve digital delivery channels.
sources.caution: BOI strategy does not establish a partnership with Runners Futurum.

sources.title: BOI iProgrammes Intervention Funds
claims: iProgrammes is BOI's centralized gateway for intervention fund programmes.
Official portal lists RAPID, GLOW, BOI/NCDMB and other intervention initiatives.
RAPID provides financial support and business advisory services to nano, micro and small businesses in rural and economically disadvantaged areas.
GLOW is an intervention fund for women-owned businesses.
sources.caution: Programme availability, eligibility and deadlines can change; evaluator must never determine actual eligibility or submit an application.

sources.title: BOI website — MyBOI portal
claims: BOI's official homepage advertises MyBOI as a live portal to apply, track and manage loan applications for BOI facilities.
sources.caution: Distinguish MyBOI general loan services from iProgrammes intervention funds; do not claim access to either.

sources.title: Bank of Industry Records unprecedented lending to enterprises in 2025
claims: This BOI publication reports ₦636 billion disbursed in 2025 to more than 7,000 businesses.
This figure differs from ₦644.9 billion cited in Runners Futurum's August proposal and another BOI public impact page.
sources.caution: Do not collapse discrepant figures. Quote amount, source, and report date; seek authoritative reconciliation before using in financial scenarios.

sources.title: BOI Impact Report 2025: N644.9bn Disbursement & Jobs
claims: This BOI page uses ₦644.9 billion in its impact-report headline.
sources.caution: A separate BOI publication states ₦636 billion. Preserve source attribution; avoid asserting they measure the same accounting category.

sources.title: Runnerbot 2 for BOI — Institutional Pilot Proposal, final (2)
sources.sourceId: Library: Runners Futurum - Runners Intel - BOI Proposal Final(2).pdf
claims: Proposes a 90-day pilot for one programme and one bounded applicant cohort, no upfront technology fee and no applicant charge.
Positions Runnerbot 2 upstream of BOI's existing application processes, with decisions retained by BOI officers and BDSPs.
Commercial scenarios are illustrative; interest income is not profit.
sources.caution: Confidential proposal. Do not expose this document or its unpublished commercial assumptions on the public website or in public GitHub.

sources.title: Runnerbot 2 for BOI — Technical & Security Appendix (2)
sources.sourceId: Library: Runners Futurum - Runners Intel - BOI Technical Security Appendix(2).pdf
claims: Describes a proposed architecture and governance posture, not a completed BOI-connected system.
Explicitly excludes integration with core lending/decisioning, applicant records and iProgrammes during the pilot.
Identifies BOI-controlled cloud deployment as a possible future option subject to BOI requirements.
sources.caution: Confidential and not approved by BOI. No actual Microsoft Copilot, Azure tenant or BOI-system integration may be claimed.

sources.title: BOI Launches MyBOI Portal to Simplify Access to Business Financing
claims: MyBOI went live on October 2, 2026 across official web and mobile channels.
The portal supports onboarding, forms and assessment, formal application submission, required document upload, application-status updates and communications.
BOI established hypercare and a MyBOI Situation Room for operational monitoring and resolution.
sources.caution: Runnerbot is NOT another application gateway, status tracker, hypercare system, or a replacement for BOI's official customer support. It cannot access application records or portal sessions.

sources.title: MyBOI Portal — FAQ and programme information
claims: The MyBOI portal already contains searchable programme information, published FAQs and support contacts.
The portal site exposes Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo variants and additional language routes; do not claim multilingual support as a unique Runnerbot capability.
MyBOI confirms separate portals for grants and intervention programmes; MyBOI's application tracking and saved drafts already function as published.
sources.caution: The existence of language routes does not establish translation quality or conversational AI support. Review production language coverage before making exact claims.

sources.title: BOI Business Advisory — 2026 BDSP Directory and Roles
claims: BOI publishes a current 2026 BDSP directory and lists 416 SME consultants.
BDSPs already help enterprises prepare plans, package documents and engage the Bank.
BOI says engaging a BDSP is not mandatory for applicants.
sources.caution: Runnerbot should extend BDSP capacity by producing transparent, human-reviewable self-reported preparation summaries rather than duplicate BDSP advisory, replace consultants or act as a relationship officer.

sources.title: BOI and Federal Ministry of Youth Development partner for 500 youth skills
claims: BOI launched a 500-person youth empowerment pilot with the Federal Ministry of Youth Development.
Sapphital, described as an AI-powered learning-management and custom-software provider, will deliver the learning component via NiYA.
sources.caution: Do not compete as an unspecified LMS or claim this partnership is open to Runnerbot. Differentiation is applicant readiness and BDSP case preparation, if selected by BOI.

sources.title: BOI-UNDP Enterprise Growth and Inclusive Industrialisation Partnership
claims: BOI and UNDP signed a three-year MoU to strengthen enterprise competitiveness, access to finance and markets, with attention to women and young people.
sources.caution: These are partnership objectives, not outcomes attributable to Runnerbot or a guaranteed procurement opportunity.

sources.title: BOI and IFC sign $50m senior loan within up-to-$100m package
claims: BOI and IFC signed a US$50m seven-year senior loan toward MSME and productive enterprise financing within a possible package of up to US$100m.
At least 25% of the loan proceeds are intended for women-owned enterprises.
Completion of definitive documentation and customary conditions was still required as of publication.
sources.caution: Do not imply the committed facility has already disbursed or can cover hypothetical incremental lending.

sources.title: MyBOI BDSP responsibilities and support
claims: BDSP assistance is optional. Applicants submit through their own MyBOI profiles.
BDSPs may help organise plans, financial models and documentation; they must not retain portal credentials.
No separate BDSP application-tracking dashboard or formal representative appointment is currently provided.
sources.caution: Preparation summaries here are synthetic and not an appointment, official referral or completed handoff.

sources.title: RAPID — Rural Area Programme on Investment for Development
claims: RAPID supports enterprise development in rural and economically disadvantaged communities through financing, advisory support and training for nano, micro and small businesses.
Public guidance requests business planning and formal application evidence; identity requirements belong only in official BOI channels.
sources.caution: Published target is not an individual eligibility finding. Verify current programme terms and opening before applying. Do not collect BVNs or NINs here.

sources.title: GLOW — Guaranteed Loans for Women
claims: GLOW supports women-owned enterprises, including manufacturing and processing, with finance, business development, capacity building and mentorship.
Published uses include production equipment and raw-material working capital.
sources.caution: GLOW is a programme name, not a guarantee of approval. Ownership evidence and full current terms require BOI review.

sources.title: MyBOI — Customer Support Disclaimer
claims: MyBOI is a self-service financing portal. BDSP engagement is optional; applicants remain responsible for information and submit through their own profiles.
BOI disclaims unauthorised BDSP fees, representations or promises.
sources.caution: Do not represent a preparation export as a formal handover, submission or authorisation.

sources.title: Runnerbot evaluator release 2026-11-09.1
claims: Signed evaluator/admin sessions; server-side bounded live inference; deterministic readiness and financial illustrations; synthetic scenario playback; metadata-only budget audit.
No BOI systems or Microsoft 365 tenant are connected. Only administrators can inspect the budget or suspend inference.
sources.caution: Implementation description; test evidence is in the release record. No institutional accuracy or effectiveness percentage claimed.

positioning: Private evaluation only: preparation-quality, evidence-based self-reported documentation review, BDSP handoff assistance, and measurable reductions in rework; no application submission, eligibility determination, official status tracking or BOI-system integration.
confidentiality: Only summarize published information and already-public high-level pilot framing in this public repository. Full proposal/security appendix remain confidential and must NOT be committed.
